title: Corpse Run, Part 3-and-then-some
description: Corpse Run, Part 3-and-then-some — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Jerome's Bones

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Kill enemies throughout Shadow's Embrace. Bring any loot with Jerome Lester's name on it to him in the Shadow's Gate.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Jerome's Bones

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: The Shadow's Embrace (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Kill enemies throughout Shadow's Embrace. Bring any loot with Jerome Lester's name on it to him in the Shadow's Gate.

Offer:

This development gets more revoltin' with each new item ya bring back to me. I gotta have all my stuff back before I can resurrect, I'm sure of it. While yer killin' things anywhere in Shadow's Embrace, check t' see if any of yer new loot's got my name on it. Bring me back any armor or jewelry that was once mine. I'll just wait here 'til you return.

Of course, I ain't got nowhere else t' go.

Turn-in:

Are you really tryin' t' help me, or are you just goin' through the motions? 'Cause you still haven't brought back all my lost loot. And without *everything*, I ain't gonna be able to come back t' life, consarn ya!

Objectives:

  • Jerome Lester's Loot ×1

Client level range: 45–52
